# Every Free AI API in 2026: The Complete Guide to Zero-Cost Inference
You don't need to spend a dollar to run frontier AI models. That isn't a pitch or a caveat-laden promise. In 2026, multiple providers offer truly free API access to models that would have cost hundreds of dollars per month just two years ago. Llama 3.3 70B, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Mixtral, DeepSeek R1 - all available at zero cost if you know where to look

# Free Llama API
Meta's Llama models, free across 10 providers — no Meta account and no credit card.

FreeLLMAPI is a free, open-source LLM API that routes across every provider with a real free tier. The Llama models below are served free by **AI Horde, Aion Labs, Cloudflare Workers AI, Groq, HuggingFace Router, NVIDIA NIM, NavyAI, OVH AI Endpoints, Ollama Cloud, SEA-LION** — reachable through one OpenAI-compatible key, with automatic failover when a provider hits its rate limit

No credit card. OpenAI-compatible base URL opencode.ai/zen/v1. List free models: opencode models |
| OpenRouter | api\_key | Rate-limited free | cohere/north-mini-code:free, dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free, google/gemma-4-31b-it:free, inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-fin:free, inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante:free, +13 more | Updated via GitHub Connect test (2026-08-12) |
| Google AI Studio (Gemini API) | api\_key | Rate-limited free | gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, +15 more | Free forever, no card, most generous major-provider tier. Live-verified against the v1beta API with an API key (2026-08-12) — model list and context windows are real; per-account quota varies by account age (see AI Studio rate-limit dashboard). Free-tier data may be used for training. |
| Groq | api\_key | Rate-limited free | openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b, qwen/qwen3.6-27b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b, meta-llama/llama-prompt-guard-2-22m, groq/compound | LPU hardware, fastest time-to-first-token. Limits per API key per model; some models get half allowance. No credit card. Limits visible in x-ratelimit-\* response headers. |
| Cerebras | api\_key | Rate-limited free (Free Trial) | gpt-oss-120b, gemma-4-31b | Wafer-scale hardware, 2,000+ tok/s. Free tier caps context at 8K (temporary). Per-model limits on a rotating shortlist. No credit card. |
| Cloudflare Workers AI | api\_key | Rate-limited free | \~80 free models (Llama 3.x/4, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek-R1 distills, FLUX, Whisper, BGE embeddings) | Neurons are normalized GPU-compute units, shared pool across all models. Resets 00:00 UTC. Hard stop when pool exhausted, errors not overage. No credit card. |
| Hugging Face | api\_key | Rate-limited free | Llama 3.2 8B (Serverless), Qwen 2.5 7B (Serverless), Mistral 7B (Serverless), Inference Providers gateway (15+ partners) | Two products: Serverless API (free, rate-limited) and Inference Providers gateway. Cold starts 10-30s on unpopular models. Limits not published as fixed numbers. |
| Mistral La Plateforme | api\_key | Rate-limited free (Experiment) | Mistral Large, Codestral, All API models (Experiment tier) | Phone (SMS) verification required, no card. Exact limits no longer published - see Admin Console Limits per workspace. Evaluation tier, not production. |
| SambaNova Cloud | api\_key | Rate-limited free | DeepSeek-V3.1, DeepSeek-V3.2, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, MiniMax-M2.7, MiniMax-M3, gemma-4-31B-it, +1 more | OpenAI-compatible base URL api.sambanova.ai/v1. Preview models can be pulled at any time. No credit card, no phone verification. |
| NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com) | api\_key | Trial credits | GLM-5, Kimi-2.5, NIM-packaged open models | Credit-based, not a rate-limited-free tier. Larger grants need corporate email, tie to \~90-day evaluation windows. |
| Z.AI (Zhipu) | api\_key | Rate-limited free | GLM-5.1, GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) | Free-tier limits revised twice in the past year - verify. Peak-hour throttling. Flash models are free regardless of tier. OpenAI-compatible. |
| Together AI | api\_key | Trial credits | 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek) | One-time credit, not forever-free. Card required once credits run out. Startup programs can grant far more. |

# 3 Ways to Access Llama 4 for Free
## 1. Meta.ai
  Meta provides direct access to the Llama 4 models through their official platform. By visiting Meta.ai, you can explore the capabilities of Llama 4 in a user-friendly environment. The platform offers a chat interface where you can test the model’s reasoning, coding, and multimodal capabilities (text + image input). This is a great way to experience the model’s power without needing to download or run it locally.
